title: High-Sensitivity and High-Resolution In Situ Hybridization of Coding and Long Non-coding RNAs
author: Takei, Nakamura, et al.
materials: For in situ hybridization, stock solutions were prepared as follows. 20X saline-sodium citrate (20X SSC: 3 M NaCl, 300 mM sodium citrate; pH 7.0) was autoclaved and stored. Torula RNA (Sigma) was dissolved in DDW at 50 °C and purified by phenol-, phenol-chloroform-, and chloroform-extraction. The RNA was precipitated, dissolved in DDW (10 mg/ml) and stored at − 20 °C. 20X Denhardt’s solution was prepared by dissolving Ficol-400 (0.4%), polyvinylpyrrolidone (0.4%) and bovine serum albumin (0.4%) in DDW and was stored at − 20 °C.

DIG- and fluorescein-labeled RNA probes were prepared by in vitro transcription with RNA polymerases and plasmid vectors containing target transcript sequences. One μg of linearized plasmid DNAs was used as a template, and RNA probes were synthesized with SP6, T7 or T3 RNA polymerase (Roche) and DIG or Fluorescein RNA Labeling Mix (Roche) for 2–3 h at 37 °C. After precipitation with ethanol and lithium chloride, the RNA probes were dissolved in DDW. After determining the concentrations, the RNA probes were diluted (50 ng/μl) with probe dilution buffer (50% formamide, 5X SSC, 0.1% Tween-20) containing torula RNA (5 mg/ml) and were stored at − 20 °C.

steps.title: Dissect and Fix Ovarian/Testis Tissue
steps.instruction: Dissect zebrafish ovaries in zebrafish Ringer’s solution (116 mM NaCl, 2.9 mM KCl, 1.8 mM CaCl₂, 5 mM HEPES, pH 7.2) and mouse ovaries/testes in PBS (137 mM NaCl, 2.7 mM KCl, 10 mM Na₂HPO₄, 2 mM KH₂PO₄, pH 7.2); cut zebrafish ovaries into 5–10 mm pieces; fix zebrafish ovaries and mouse ovaries in 4 % paraformaldehyde/PBS for 3 h to overnight at 4 °C, then wash three times with PBS; fix mouse testes in 4 % paraformaldehyde/PBS for exactly 3 h at 4 °C, then immediately wash three times with PBS (longer fixation of mouse testes causes shrinkage).

substeps.instruction: Dissect zebrafish ovaries in Ringer’s solution under SZ‑ST dissecting microscope (Olympus).
Dissect mouse ovaries and testes (8‑week‑old) in PBS.
Cut zebrafish ovaries into 5–10 mm pieces with forceps.
Fix zebrafish ovaries and mouse ovaries in 4 % PFA/PBS for 3 h to overnight at 4 °C.
Fix mouse testes in 4 % PFA/PBS for 3 h at 4 °C.
Wash all fixed tissues three times with PBS (immediately for testes).

steps.title: Prepare Stock Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare and store the following solutions: 20X SSC (3 M NaCl, 300 mM sodium citrate, pH 7.0) autoclaved; Torula RNA (Sigma) dissolved in DDW at 50 °C, purified by phenol, phenol‑chloroform, and chloroform extraction, precipitated, redissolved at 10 mg/ml in DDW and stored at –20 °C; 20X Denhardt’s solution made by dissolving Ficol‑400 (0.4 %), polyvinylpyrrolidone (0.4 %) and bovine serum albumin (0.4 %) in DDW, stored at –20 °C.

substeps.instruction: Autoclave 20X SSC (3 M NaCl, 300 mM sodium citrate, pH 7.0) and store.
Dissolve Torula RNA in DDW at 50 °C, purify by phenol, phenol‑chloroform, and chloroform extraction, precipitate, redissolve to 10 mg/ml in DDW, store at –20 °C.
Prepare 20X Denhardt’s solution: dissolve Ficol‑400 (0.4 %), polyvinylpyrrolidone (0.4 %) and BSA (0.4 %) in DDW, store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Synthesize Labeled RNA Probes
steps.instruction: Linearize plasmid DNA and use 1 µg template per reaction; perform in‑vitro transcription with SP6, T7 or T3 RNA polymerase (Roche) and DIG or Fluorescein RNA Labeling Mix (Roche) at 37 °C for 2–3 h; precipitate RNA with ethanol and lithium chloride, dissolve in DDW, determine concentration, then dilute to 50 ng/µl in probe dilution buffer (50 % formamide, 5X SSC, 0.1 % Tween‑20) containing torula RNA at 5 mg/ml; store diluted probes at –20 °C.

substeps.instruction: Linearize plasmid DNA; use 1 µg per transcription reaction.
Transcribe with SP6/T7/T3 polymerase and DIG or Fluorescein RNA Labeling Mix at 37 °C for 2–3 h.
Precipitate RNA with ethanol and lithium chloride; dissolve in DDW.
Measure RNA concentration.
Dilute RNA to 50 ng/µl in buffer (50 % formamide, 5X SSC, 0.1 % Tween‑20) containing torula RNA (5 mg/ml).
Store diluted probes at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Specific RNA Probes for Targets
steps.instruction: Prepare eight DIG‑labeled antisense and sense probes for full‑length mouse Pou5f1/Oct4 and zebrafish cyclin B1 transcripts and for partial zebrafish dazl and mouse Dazl transcripts; prepare six fluorescein‑labeled antisense and sense probes for full‑length zebrafish mos, zebrafish cyclin B1, and mouse Cyclin B1 transcripts; prepare two DIG‑labeled and two fluorescein‑labeled antisense and sense probes for full‑length lncRNA‑HSVIII. (Sequences are listed in the supplementary tables.)

steps.title: Hoechst Nuclear Staining and Mounting
steps.instruction: Incubate samples with 10 µg/ml Hoechst 33258 for 10 min; mount with either Prolong Antifade Kit (Molecular Probes) or Fluoro‑KEEPER Antifade Reagent (Nacalai Tesque); image using an LSM5 LIVE confocal microscope (Carl Zeiss).

substeps.instruction: Incubate samples in 10 µg/ml Hoechst 33258 for 10 min.
Mount samples with Prolong Antifade Kit or Fluoro‑KEEPER Antifade Reagent.
Observe under LSM5 LIVE confocal microscope.

steps.title: Hematoxylin‑Eosin Staining of Sections
steps.instruction: After rehydration, wash sections with running water for 5 min, stain with hematoxylin solution for 2 min, wash running water for 30 min, stain with eosin solution for 30 s, wash running water for 3 min, dehydrate sequentially in 70 %, 80 %, 90 %, 95 %, and 99 % ethanol (1 min each), incubate in xylene for 1 min, mount with MGK‑S mounting medium (Matsunami Glass Industries), and observe under an Axioskop microscope.

substeps.instruction: Wash sections with running water for 5 min.
Incubate in hematoxylin staining solution for 2 min.
Wash with running water for 30 min.
Incubate in eosin staining solution for 30 s.
Wash with running water for 3 min.
Dehydrate in 70 %, 80 %, 90 %, 95 %, and 99 % ethanol, 1 min each.
Incubate in xylene for 1 min.
Mount with MGK‑S mounting medium.
Observe under Axioskop microscope.
